arcs.title: 主线起步
arcs.goal: 明确主角处境、核心目标和第一轮外部压力。
arcs.stakes: 如果主角不行动，将失去当前最重要的资源或关系。
arcs.payoff: 主角完成第一次可信突破，并留下下一阶段更大的问题。

characters.name: 主角
characters.goal: 补全长期目标和短期目标。
characters.knownSecrets: 只记录当前章节前已经知道的信息。
characters.relationshipNotes: 记录队友、竞争者、债主或师承关系。
characters.coreWound: The private hurt or shame that makes this character overreact.
characters.desire: What the character wants in the next visible chapter window.
characters.misbelief: The wrong belief that creates repeated choices and eventual growth.
characters.redemptionArc: How the character may repair a mistake through costly action.
characters.sublimationGoal: How private desire can rise into duty, oath, or larger value.
characters.smallPersonHighlight: A concrete high-light moment where an ordinary person changes the scene.
characters.relationshipPressure: The relationship debt, rivalry, trust gap, or obligation pushing choices.

events.title: 第一处特殊事件
events.trigger: 主角达到第一个小目标，但需要外部压力迫使他组队行动。
events.conflict: 收益可观，但会暴露主角不该轻易暴露的信息。
events.reward: 能力、资源、关系或线索上的小突破。
events.cost: 留下代价、伤势、债务、敌意或更大的追踪风险。
events.foreshadowing: 提前 2-3 章埋入异常物件、传闻或地图碎片。
events.readerPayoff: Setup a visible payoff with pressure, cost, action, reward, and aftershock.

craftBeats.label: first earned payoff
craftBeats.setup: The protagonist lacks a resource or status.
craftBeats.payoff: A small but irreversible gain changes future options.
craftBeats.cost: The gain leaves debt, exposure, injury, or a stronger enemy.

orchestrationNotes: AI 编排未来章节时必须让事件由角色动机和代价触发，避免无因刷副本或突然升级。
